title: Graphic Intent Taxonomy
description: Defines the role and density of graphic/typographic overlays. Does not prescribe visual templates.

values.description: No graphic or typographic overlay; pure photographic/human frame.
Subtle supporting identifier (e.g. clean location tag or small badge).
Secondary graphic assisting voice without demanding focal dominance.
Structured data presentation aiding factual comprehension.
Card or structured overlay acting as key visual focus alongside presenter.
